note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Guides are this entry's own words, with their sources cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do beyond them. Follow the roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion, and the hardest trophy in the set. After the final mission, the 100% Completion checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx notes the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly, and you need 70 of the 80 challenges, but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Expect about 100 hours for this step alone.
